sections.title: About this guide
data: Station Chincoteague is a small-boat search and rescue station of Sector Virginia. Its home count comes from the Coast Guard's housing map; the rest comes from Coast Guard news releases about the station.
Ask your sponsor before you move.

sections.title: Coast Guard Housing
data: The Coast Guard's housing map lists a Wallops Island housing site for this station with 28 active homes. Wallops Island is about 10 road miles from the station (public maps).
The Navy's Surface Combat Systems Center at Wallops Island runs its own housing office; it is not the Coast Guard's. Ask the station for the Coast Guard local housing officer.

In the Coast Guard, assignment to Coast Guard housing is generally mandatory when a home is available, and BAH starts only after the housing office releases you to rent in town. Ask your sponsor for the local housing officer before you look at rentals.
